lines.1: I look up toward the voice.
lines.2: A figure stands aboard the ship that came charging in.
lines.3: 「And I am Serebu's father and the elder brother of that fool over there... Hup!」
lines.4: The figure leaps high into the air.
lines.7: Dramatic entrance aside, he completely botches the landing.
lines.10: 「I did not fall! I did not! I, Ikuzo Tachibana, the Old Wolf of Matsukasa, did not fall! I did not!」
lines.11: He said the exact same thing twice.
lines.14: These two at the top are way too intense.
lines.15: 「C-can it be? The Old Wolf of Matsukasa?」
lines.17: 「Of course. They say there isn't a soul in the Matsukasa Navy who doesn't know his name.」
lines.18: 「Still on active duty at his age, with the strength to remain at the very top. He truly is the Old Wolf of Matsukasa... a living legend.」
lines.19: 「And that battleship, the Hatsuhi, is said to be the Old Wolf of Matsukasa's den.」
lines.20: So that battleship is different from the one in Matsukasa Park?
lines.21: 「Otome, I will take care of matters here. Direct the students into the school building.」
lines.23: Otome comes back over to us.
lines.26: 「Murata and Date, you were here too? I haven't suffered so much as a scratch. I'm fine.」
lines.27: 「More importantly, the bell has already rung. Hurry to your classroom.」
lines.33: 「You lot, hurry to your classrooms too! The bell rang ages ago!」
lines.40: 「Naturally. She is of the Kurogane bloodline, after all.」
